technical-summary: Refactored gpt-auto adapter to use session transport as its core (thin open→prompt→close wrapper, ~213 lines removed). Fixed _is_new() in session transport to compare against baseline text instead of accepting any non-empty text — on turn 2+ the stability window would lock onto stale content from previous turns. Made response_stability_seconds configurable via GptAutoConfig (default 6s) so tests can use shorter values. Updated test config with longer timeout and shorter stability for faster runs.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed gpt-auto session transport returning stale responses on subsequent turns; made response stability window configurable; refactored adapter to delegate fully to the session transport.
